MP High Court Assistant Grade III Online Form 2026 – Extend – Full Details

Madhya Pradesh High Court MPHC has released the notification for the post of Assistant Grade III. This recruitment has been issued for 1174 posts. Online applying process for MP High Court Assistant Grade III Recruitment 2026 has started from 17 August 2026 & the candidates can apply till 30 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for MP High Court Assistant Grade III Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 17 August 2026
  • Last Date : 30 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 September 2026
  • Correction Date : 06-08 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 943.40/-
  • SC, ST, EWS, OBC & PwBD : Rs. 743.40/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
